crime: {WITCH_NAME} had told only one girl how she grew up in a cult and escaped. At midday, that girl forwarded the story to the prison group chat. The replies showed how far it had spread.

That evening, {WITCH_NAME} asked to meet the girl alone in the lounge. The reply came: the girl was waiting. Before entering, she fixed her skin's appearance, calm and unmarked. She took the crossbow from the wall, held its stock against her shoulder, and shot the girl in the chest at close range. She wiped the weapon, hung it back up, and left looking untouched.

The prisoner who found the body also found a triangular wood chip that fitted a fresh break in the crossbow's shoulder stock. Its broken corner would have struck the shooter with the recoil. {WITCH_NAME}'s shoulder looked smooth, but when the prisoners touched it, they felt a fresh triangular welt matching the break. Her magic had hidden the swelling, and the dead girl's last message had placed their meeting there.
fields.epitaph: Beneath the same smile, nothing had stayed the same.
execution: A clear, flexible hood descended over her head and shoulders and tightened against her face. Its surface moved with every breath and struggle. It sealed over her nose and mouth and stayed there as the movements weakened and stopped.

magic.name: Fixed Appearance
magic.text: She can freeze the visible appearance of her skin.
